title: Persisted conversation session identity
description: F1: the stored `sessions` row (clozn/runs/migrations.py migration 4, clozn/runs/sessions.py) -- an opaque conversation entity that REFERENCES run rows by clozn.runs.association.session_key() equality (runs.session_key = sessions.id); it never embeds run content or a run-id list, so run documents stay immutable and this row never needs rewriting when a run is added. Deliberately narrow: only session-level IDENTITY/metadata is a stored, schema-validated field here. `first_activity_ts`/`last_activity_ts`/`run_count` are NOT part of this schema -- they are computed live from the `runs` table on every read (see clozn/runs/sessions.py) and appear only in the runtime read view, never in what gets persisted or validated here.

id.description: The SAME opaque key clozn.runs.association.session_key() already writes into runs.session_key -- either an HMAC-SHA256 digest (truncated to 24 hex chars) of a caller-supplied raw token, or an already-opaque key a caller reused as-is. Two callers supplying the identical raw token land on the identical id by construction: this is the documented, INTENTIONAL cross-client reuse/merge point (see clozn/runs/sessions.py module docstring), not a collision bug.

client_key.description: The creating client's opaque identity facet (clozn.runs.association.client_key()). Omitted, never null, when the session was created without a resolvable client identity, or when a lazily-backfilled legacy session's member runs carry more than one distinct client_key (ambiguous provenance is never guessed at).

title.description: Optional caller-set label. Omitted, never an empty string, when unset.

privacy.description: Session-level metadata visibility only. Content-level redaction of individual runs remains clozn.runs.mutations.redact_run's job and is out of this entity's scope entirely.

visibility.description: 'hidden' excludes the session from default listings (clozn.runs.sessions.list_sessions); it never affects whether member runs are readable, deletable, or redactable.

materialized_from.description: 'explicit': created via clozn.runs.sessions.create_session (created_ts is the true creation time). 'lazy_backfill': persisted later by clozn.runs.sessions.materialize_session for a legacy session_key that already had member runs but no session row yet -- created_ts is then an HONEST approximation (the earliest member run's recorded_ts), not the session's true first-use time, which pre-dates this table and was never captured.
